podcasts.title: Andrew Huberman - The Frontier of Neurotechnology - [Invest Like the Best, EP.494]
podcasts.description: Andrew Huberman is a neuroscientist and professor at Stanford, the host of the Huberman Lab podcast, and the author of Protocols. Most of our conversation is about where neuroscience goes next. For decades the field has focused on reading from the brain, and Andrew believes the next era is about writing to it with precise control over specific brain states.
